# The second shape, in the spelling the packaging job carried twice: an awk
# program written out over several lines, with the file alone on the line that
# closes it. No vocabulary can see this one, because the tool is three lines
# further up, and that is why the rule has a second half.
      - name: The packaged list equals the artifact list
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected=$(awk '
            /^artifacts:/ {inblock=1; next}
            inblock && /^-/ {gsub(/^- *"?/,""); print}
          ' build.yaml | sort)
          echo "::error::build.yaml lists nothing."
